verdict.rationale: Postman documents a public API for programmatically managing assets and a CLI that can run collections, checks, and governance rules in CI/CD pipelines, which supports APIOps-style automation of specs/collections/mocks from CI (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19, postman-docs-22). However there is no evidence of a true declarative config model (e.g. version-controlled YAML/JSON manifests diffed and applied) or of Postman managing actual gateway/traffic infrastructure as code, as opposed to test/collection assets. Missing for 10: explicit declarative-config/state-sync workflow, gateway infrastructure management (routes, policies), and a Terraform/IaC-style provider for GitOps.
